blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 at Ethereum block 25712115 and BNB Chain block 114787010. The official inventory identifies Ethereum 0xc5d6a7b61d18afa11435a889557b068bb9f29930 and BNB Chain 0x8ba9da757d1d66c58b1ae7e2ed6c04087348a82d as sUSDD; both remained identical-size direct deployments with zero EIP-1967 implementation slots. Their verified SavingsUsdd source exposes ordinary ERC-20 transfers and allowance-gated ERC-4626 withdrawals, with no owner, role administration, pause, blacklist, denylist, seizure, or arbitrary-holder burn. The inherited finding comes solely from tracked parent usdd-tron-dao-reserve, whose 2026-08-10 all-chain reserve review resolves Upstream; sUSDD does not receive a direct holder-freeze flag.

oracleRisk.summary: sUSDD is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over USDD and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or local liquidation engine. Its required USDD parent carries the separately reviewed governed CDP oracle, auction, deficit, and shutdown branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDD documents sUSDD as an ERC-4626 tokenized vault minted when users deposit USDD and redeemable back to USDD through its exchange rate. The savings wrapper does not originate borrower debt or operate collateral-ratio-triggered liquidations. The variantOf relationship preserves the complete USDD parent branch review.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: sUSDD is the immutable SavingsUsdd wrapper deployed natively on Ethereum and BNB Chain over natively-issued USDD on each chain (per-chain bytecode diff 2026-07-20; USDD's BNB Chain deployment is native per the official deployment registry). No bridge route carries the claim.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-2 (lead usdc-circle)

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: sUSDD on Ethereum is the immutable SavingsUsdd wrapper (no proxy, no owner(); bytecode read 2026-07-20) minting sUSDD against USDD deposits.

Native deployment: the BSC sUSDD is the same immutable SavingsUsdd ERC-4626 wrapper (11,085-byte contract, name 'Savings Usdd'; bytecode differs from the Ethereum wrapper only in the embedded per-chain protocol addresses, diffed 2026-07-20) wrapping natively-issued BNB Chain USDD 0x45E51bc23D592EB2DBA86da3985299f7895d66Ba — USDD announced native deployment on BNB Chain (Oct 2025) with the full CDP stack, so no bridge mints this deployment.
